title: Jorge Messi, Father and Agent of Lionel Messi, Dies at 68
dek: Jorge Messi, the father and long-time agent of Lionel Messi, has died in Argentina at age 68. He had reportedly been dealing with health issues over the summer. His death marks the end of a relationship that shaped one of modern football's defining careers.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Jorge Messi died at age 68 in Argentina after reported summer health issues.
bottom_line: The loss of Jorge Messi removes a constant presence from Lionel Messi's personal and professional life at a point when the player continues his career in Major League Soccer. Questions about Lionel Messi's representation and the family's next steps remain unaddressed in current reporting.
body: Jorge Messi, the father and long-time agent of Lionel Messi, has died in Argentina at age 68, according to CBS Sports reporting.

Jorge Messi had reportedly been dealing with health issues over the summer during the World Cup period. The specific cause of death and the exact date within that timeframe have not been disclosed in available reporting.

As both Lionel Messi's father and his representative throughout his football career, Jorge Messi was a central figure in one of sport's most prominent player-agent relationships. His role extended far beyond typical representation, embedding him in major decisions about his son's club moves, contract negotiations, and public profile across decades of play at Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain, and Inter Miami.
